g.id: Raised column: where the idea acts

path.id: The domain-aware software engineer who guides an agent by providing it with enough structure to make it useful but still owns the final judgment.
Detect and surface missing architectural and query context before code is generated, so the engineer can prevent unauthorized agent inferences.

P1 Senior full-stack engineer Â· P2 Senior / lead engineer Â· P3 Principal backend engineer Â· P4 Junior engineer, 10 months Â· P5 Director, Software Engineering, leads 12 engineers Â· P6 Senior full-stack engineer, new greenfield application

path.id: LINE OF VISIBILITY. Below this line is what the engineer does not see but what shapes each phase.
structures and processes behind the experience

path.id: Gathers repo patterns, the tech stack, and cross-repo or undocumented dependencies, flags what is missing, and suggests which files to attach, so the engineer sends a complete, right-sized context package. Addresses: other-repo context, undocumented facts, how much context is enough.
Record AI assumptions and force explicit human gating

The agent records each assumption with a reason and shows them as a plan before code is written. Asking at real gaps is a related idea with limited evidence (P5, P6). Addresses: silent assumptions, plan before code.
